links.outcome: Model performance versus endocrinologists (F1-score) for acromegaly detection on hand images
links.effect: Model achieved sensitivity 0.89, specificity 0.91, AUC 0.96, outperforming specialists (F1-score range: 0.43-0.63).
links.quote: The model achieved a sensitivity of 0.89, specificity of 0.91, positive predictive value of 0.88, negative predictive value of 0.93, F1-score of 0.89, and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.96, outperforming specialists (F1-score range: 0.43-0.63).

unlisted_practices: Privacy-conscious image design excluding palm/fingerprint regions from hand images used for model development

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a deep learning diagnostic model on hand images for detecting acromegaly, comparing its performance to endocrinologists in a multicenter retrospective test set without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
